name: Smart Schema Normaliser
description: Cleans up an export with untidy field names: makes the names lower case with underscores, merges fields whose names differ only in case, spaces or dashes, and gives each text field a number, date, yes/no or text type, working through the data in chunks so large inputs never have to fit in memory.
introductoryText:
Tidies the field names and types of an export whose columns are named and typed inconsistently, for example data appended from two systems.

**Names**: each field name is trimmed, made lower case, and spaces and dashes become single underscores (`Sign-up Date` becomes `sign_up_date`). Fields whose names become the same are **merged** into one: the first field's value, or the next field's where it is missing (or empty, with **Prefer non-empty values**).

**Types**: each text field is given the first type that fits at least the **Auto cast threshold** share of its values (missing values don't count): number (whole numbers become Integer), date, yes/no (`true/false`, `yes/no`, `y/n`, `t/f`, `1/0`), or else text. Values that don't fit the chosen type become empty. Text with a leading zero (`00123`) stays text; text counts as a date only with a four-digit year or a day/month/year pattern. Fields that already have a type are kept as they are. The block streams: the types are decided from the first chunk of records (10,000) and kept for the rest, so a later value that doesn't fit its field's type becomes empty too, and the block's message counts these values.

**Missing values** stay missing unless you set a default for numbers, dates or text.

options.name: prefer_non_empty_strings
options.title: Prefer non-empty values
options.description: When merging fields, an empty text value is replaced by the next field's value, like a missing one.

options.name: sort_columns
options.title: Sort fields by name
options.description: Order the output fields alphabetically. Unticked, they keep the order of their first appearance.

options.name: auto_cast_threshold
options.title: Auto cast threshold
options.description: Share of a field's values (0 to 1, missing values not counted) that must fit a type for the field to get it. Default 0.98.

options.name: day_first
options.title: Day first
options.description: Read ambiguous dates such as 04/03/2024 as 4 March. Unticked, 3 April. Dates starting with a four-digit year are always year-month-day.

options.name: number_default
options.title: Default for missing numbers
options.description: Optional. A number (such as 0) to put in empty values of number fields. Empty: they stay missing.

options.name: datetime_default
options.title: Default for missing dates
options.description: Optional. A date (such as 1970-01-01) to put in empty values of date fields. Empty: they stay missing.

options.name: string_default
options.title: Default for missing text
options.description: Optional. Text to put in empty values of text fields. Empty: they stay missing.

blockOutputs.label: Normalised
blockOutputs.tooltip: The input with tidied field names, merged duplicate fields and inferred types.
